question: In a certain code language, ‘DRIVER’ is written as ‘JSETGX’ and 'DURING' is written as 'SVEIPK'. How will ‘DOLLAR’ be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'DRIVER’ is written as ‘JSETGX',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df3ee40a66eddf12020a7d6e05cf7beb7b3d690a3c2c26938d5e2e65d32a6937.png] 

'DURING' is written as 'SVEIPK',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc95ac57a45c24d96064c569bc01abfe11f027793c1c80f65c090cfae856733f.png] 

Similarly, for '**DOLLAR**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1da6da0fae8dfa693fb47576685ab2fea5e554f2a66b6db0a44a1827a3f18618.png] 

So, 'DOLLAR' is written as '**MPETCN**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
